name: js-flatten
instruction: Implement flatten.js (CommonJS): module.exports = { flatten, unflatten }. flatten(obj) maps a nested object/array to a flat object keyed by dotted paths, where array elements use their numeric index ('a.0.b'). An EMPTY object or array is preserved as a leaf value rather than vanishing. A key that itself contains a '.' is escaped as '\.' in the path. unflatten(flat) is the exact inverse and must rebuild arrays (a purely numeric, zero-based, gapless key set becomes an array) and unescape '\.' back to '.'. flatten(unflatten(x)) must round-trip.
